selection_contract.algorithm_freeze: the candidate is the unchanged v21 uniform control at coefficient 0.10, 512 iterations, and delayed-linear schedule; no v21 result was used to alter its algorithm or hyperparameters
selection_contract.burden_gate: candidate mean total correction RMS must not exceed 0.25 in any environment; action-change rate is reported but is not substituted for correction magnitude
selection_contract.capacity_control: all arms retain identical terminal-reserve context, network capacity, training paths, checkpoint window, and heldout paths
selection_contract.claim_boundary: support establishes only fresh-root MuJoCo evidence for correction reduction with projected-reward noninferiority; it does not establish reward superiority, cross-domain superiority, or deployment validity
selection_contract.primary_correction_gate: component and total correction must each have a pooled paired lower bound above five percent reduction, improve by at least five percent in at least two environment point estimates, and have no environment family-adjusted lower bound below negative five percent
selection_contract.primary_reward_gate: paired family-adjusted lower bounds must exceed the negative five percent reserve-reward margin in every environment, and the pooled paired lower bound must exceed the same margin
selection_contract.question: does the unchanged v21 delayed uniform consistency mechanism reduce terminal-reserve correction while preserving projected reward
selection_contract.secondary_reward_superiority: reward-superiority intervals and root wins are reported but are not required for the registered no-tradeoff confirmation
selection_contract.stopping_rule: any failed primary gate rejects the joint confirmation; roots cannot be reused to tune coefficient, schedule, thresholds, or checkpoints
selection_contract.validity_gate: all projected cells must have zero certificate violations, at least 0.95 projection convergence, at most 0.05 recursive fallback, and realized prefix powers within the frozen budgets
